what_happened: Research found the existing batch-orchestration-guardrails.md concurrency objection for a per-task postflight deploy trigger ('sibling task's own still-in-flight dispatch') does not hold at the same-cycle Move 2/Move 3 boundary by the same cycle-synchronicity argument the doc already uses for the Inter-Cycle Checkpoint; the real residual risk there is cross-session lock contention, already accepted at the two existing trigger sites. Recommendation is still no behavioral change, on cost/benefit (test-lint-deploy-caller-wrap.sh's two-caller invariant) rather than pure safety grounds.
